design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are affective/intercultural communicative awareness Likert items rather than PV-based cognitive achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The manuscript does not report the use of PISA complex survey weights, indicating that the analysis was likely unweighted.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, suggesting that it used student-level models ignoring school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as analyzing the overlap of predicted and actual responses, but does not report any validation on external datasets or different cycles.
